title: Determine the Strength of People's Character: The Law of Compulsive Behavior
coreMove: Test character by repeated behavior under pressure, dependence, and frustration rather than by talent, apology, or charm.
sourcePressure: This law replaces charisma-based judgment with slower pattern recognition: character shows through recurring compulsions under stress, frustration, dependence, and time.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Making character a moral vibe instead of a trackable pattern of compulsive behavior.

exampleSpecs.audience: an owner who likes a partner's energy but needs reliability
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a regional launch fails from avoidable chaos

sourceAnchors.name: Howard Hughes
